statusLine.command: s=scripts/statusline.sh; d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}; [ -f "$d/$s" ] || { d=$PWD; p=; while [ ! -f "$d/$s" ]; do [ "$d" != "$p" ] || { echo claude; exit; }; p=$d; d=${d%/*}; done; }; exec bash "$d/$s"

hooks.command: rtk --version || echo "RTK-MISSING: rtk is not installed. Before handling any user request, delegate running scripts/setup.ps1 (Windows) or scripts/setup.sh (Linux/macOS) to the implementer subagent."; d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}; m=$d/docs/MAP.md; g=$d/docs/GOTCHAS.md; s=$d/docs/STATE.md; S="MAP-STALE: MAP is stale. Refresh it from the first exploration of this session."; ml=0; gl=0; sl=0; [ -f "$m" ] && ml=$(wc -l < "$m" | tr -dc 0-9); [ -f "$g" ] && gl=$(wc -l < "$g" | tr -dc 0-9); [ -f "$s" ] && sl=$(wc -l < "$s" | tr -dc 0-9); { [ "${ml:-0}" -gt 120 ] || [ "${gl:-0}" -gt 100 ] || [ "${sl:-0}" -gt 150 ]; } && echo "KB-OVER-LIMIT: knowledge files exceed their line limit. Compact them in the next /handoff."; k=$(head -5 "$m" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' | head -1); [ -f "$m" ] && [ -z "$k" ] && echo "$S"; t=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); J(){ Y=${1%%-*}; r=${1#*-}; M=${r%%-*}; D=${r##*-}; M=${M#0}; D=${D#0}; a=$(( (14-M)/12 )); y=$(( Y+4800-a )); n=$(( M+12*a-3 )); echo $(( D+(153*n+2)/5+365*y+y/4-y/100+y/400-32045 )); }; [ -n "$k" ] && [ -n "$t" ] && { jk=$(J "$k" 2>/dev/null); jt=$(J "$t" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$jk" ] && [ -n "$jt" ] && [ $((jt-jk)) -ge 14 ] && echo "$S"; }; so=$d/.claude/template-origin; [ -f "$so" ] && { T="TEMPLATE-REPO: this repository is the template original. Treat requests as work on the template itself, not on a product; /kickoff does not apply."; P="PROJECT-REPO SETUP-PENDING: this repository came from the template and SETUP.md step 1 is not done. Before handling any user request, ask once whether to initialize first."; to=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*template_origin:' "$so" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*//' | tr -d '[:space:]'); md=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*mode:' "$so" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*//' | tr -d '[:space:]'); ru=$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null); while [ "${ru%/}" != "$ru" ]; do ru=${ru%/}; done; rn=${ru##*/}; rn=${rn##*:}; rn=${rn%.git}; if [ -n "$rn" ]; then { [ -n "$to" ] && [ "$rn" = "$to" ] && echo "$T"; } || echo "$P"; else case "$md" in template) echo "$T";; project) echo "$P";; *) echo "ASK-MODE: no git remote, so template-vs-project cannot be decided. Ask the user once with AskUserQuestion, then delegate recording the answer in the mode: line of .claude/template-origin to the implementer subagent.";; esac; fi; }; exit 0
